faq.question: What’s the Take It Down Act and why does it matter?
faq.anwser: It’s a new federal law banning non consensual intimate content (including AI deepfakes), forcing platforms to remove reported imagery within 48 hours or face penalties—our templates automatically cite this act for max legal weight.

faq.question: What if the platform doesn’t comply within 48 hours?
faq.anwser: Our templates cite the Take It Down Act, which legally forces platforms to remove reported content in 48 hrs. If they don’t, you can escalate with a follow-up notice or consult an attorney—our generic “escalation” template can help with that too.

faq.question: Can I customize these templates?
faq.anwser: Totally! You get both PDF and editable DOCX, so you can tweak wording, add personal details, or adjust legal citations before you send.

faq.question: How do I know if my content qualifies for removal?
faq.anwser: If it’s your copyrighted photo/video, you can use a DMCA notice. If it’s non consensual intimate imagery or a deepfake of you, our policy-violation/deepfake templates apply. When in doubt, pick the closest match or reach out at support@removemyporn.com.
